title: Panevezio celebrate U19 League title
description: Panevezio captured U19 League title. They nipped V.Knasiaus KM 86-85 in the title game today. Nikas Stuknys (194-G-2005) came up with 24 points to pace the winners. VKKM led by as many as 8 points after the first period 26-18. They maintained the lead throughout the second term. VKKM entered the second period up by 9 points 48-39. But Panevezio turned things around in the second half. They ignited a 30-21 run in the third period to erase the deficit. Panevezio then limited their opponents to just 16 points in the fourth stanza and raced to the victory. Titas Kriksciunas (2004) posted 20 points for the champions. Kristupas Keinys (202-SF-2004) netted 21 points and grabbed 23 rebounds for VKKM. Rytis Sakaitis (193-PG-2004) added 19 points in the losing effort.
